nom: Beekman 1802 Milk Shake Hyaluronic Acid & Squalane Facial Toner Mist

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-combination skin report the mist balances hydration without heaviness, though one notes wishing it dried more matte and prefers pairing it with a matte foundation.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin most consistently report strong relief from tightness and flakiness, though a few with dry skin found it insufficiently hydrating or left an unabsorbed, oily film.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (often oily T-zone, drier cheeks) report balanced hydration without T-zone greasiness, with one wishing for a better mist and one seeing no real improvement.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report no reaction and calming effects, but two describe irritation, burning, or a possible allergic response, one suspecting the blue thistle ingredient.
segments.mature: Reviewers over 40 or with mature skin report the mist helps with a hydrated, less caked makeup look and reduced appearance of fine lines/age spots.

concerns.aging: Several mature reviewers report smoother texture, less noticeable forehead lines, and faded age/dark spots with continued use; one only comments on general glow rather than specific line reduction.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, especially those identifying as dry-skinned, report significant relief from tightness and a plumped, hydrated feel; a minority found it not hydrating enough or left skin oily without absorbing.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers report the mist calms redness and irritation on dry or sensitive days; against this, one review describes it triggering a burning sensation and irritation.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer highlights the squalane supporting the skin barrier without heaviness, and another with an already-compromised barrier reports the product helped calm irritation, though one dry-skin reviewer suspected the product caused dermatitis.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports faded post-acne dark spots and shrinking pore appearance after two months of use; this is not corroborated elsewhere in the reviews supplied.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with oily/combo/acne-prone skin reports it calms breakouts and does not clog pores; no other reviewer discusses acne outcomes directly.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report the mist hydrates without an oily slick or greasy feel and pairs well with matte foundation, though one dry-skin reviewer experienced the opposite, describing it as leaving an oily, unabsorbed film.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under and over makeup
Requires shaking to remix oil layer
Long-lasting bottle, good value over time

extraits.texte: I have no idea why this product has so many positive reviews. Its not very moisturizing and it's inconvenient to use because: 1) you have to shake the bottle with every squirt to ensure the oil is mixed thoroughly. 2) you can't directly spray it on your face because the oil will get in your eyes. Yes, you can close your eyes but oil on my eyelids eventually makes its way into my eyes 3) it cant be used if you're wearing makeup because you have to spray it in your hands and then apply to your face When I purchased this I was in a hurry because the store was closing and the Ulta employee, who was helping me, recommended it based on customer reviews. I'm certainly not blaming him because it does have great reviews. But I probably should have thought about it more. I use a lot of moisturizing sprays because I have dry skin and I like to use them to set my makeup. Believe me-there are better products, especially at this price.
I have very dry skin and this mist was not as hydrating it left the skin feeling very oily and never absorbed. Would not purchase again but using it on the body not to waste it

extraits.titre: Loved the Concept, but Sadly Irritated My Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this product! I was initially drawn to it because of the clean, natural ingredients and the addition of probiotics, which seemed perfect for my sensitive skin. I'm almost done with my first bottle and had actually purchased a second one because I was so hopeful. However, I started noticing that whenever I spray it on my face, it leaves a burning sensation. I saw another review mentioning a possible allergy to blue thistle, which is in this formula, and now I'm wondering if that could be what's triggering the irritation for me. It's disappointing because I love everything else about this product — the concept, the ingredient list, and the way it feels initially. I just wish it worked better with my skin!

I'm on my third bottle of this spray. I had extremely dry skin, but just a couple of sprays have transformed my complexion. It gives me a glass-like appearance and hydrates my skin immensely. I'm so happy I decided to give it a try! If you suffer from really dry skin, I would definitely recommend this spray. It makes a huge difference.

I've tried all the viral toners and this one is by far superior- it costs more but worth it!!! I am over 40 with combination skin, so I'm picky. It's the only one that keeps my skin plump throughout the day and I always wind up returing the trendy toners and coming back to Beekman 1802.

I got the travel size of this since but I neeeeeed the big version idc if its $40😭😭. So good if you have oily or combo skin! Keeps my skin super soft, calms down my redness and it lowkey heals my breakouts, and does not clog my pores! This is like a 3 in 1 product for me, toner serum and moisturizer. Perfect for that healthy glass skin look and now in the winter time I do layer a very lightweight mouisturizer on top for extra hydration

Wow! I randomly got this for free this summer and forgot about it. Now that it's colder / drier, I'm so happy I unearthed it! I have combo skin (heavy oil on T zone, bone dry cheeks) and this is PERFECT!! So hydrating and makes your skin genuinely feel soft and moisturized all day, but not so greasy that your T Zone feels gross. I do wish the mister was better and it didnt give such a heavy spray, but that's minor.
